title: Franklin Getaway w/ Hot Tub/Fire Pit/Outdoor Space
description:
Whether you are in town to explore or catch up with old friends or family you have found your spot. For those who prefer to go out, our house is centrally located near local coffee shops, restaurants and boutiques.  Minutes to downtown Franklin, less than 20 min to Leipers Fork and 30 minutes to Nashville. At the same time, our home will offer you the perfect retreat after a busy day. We have intentionally created a space with multiple places to hang out and create memories.

The space
Every aspect of our 3 bedroom 2 bath home has been meticulously designed to give our guests a relaxing and memorable stay. 
- Large kitchen
- Spacious living area.
- Relaxing back porch, with a T.V. 
- Hot tub 
- Outdoor fire pit 
  

Sleeping arrangements: The master suite has a comfortable king sized bed and an ensuite bathroom. It also has its own cozy fireplace and T.V.  The two guest rooms are on the opposite side of the house. One of them has a queen bed and a desk for any work from home needs. The second room is a bunk room that can sleep 5 people. It has a single day bed and a bunk bed with a single over a full and a single trundle.

Complimentary Electric Vehicle Charger
- Tesla Generation 3 Wall connector
- up to 44 miles of range per hour
- 24 foot cable length conveniently located next to driveway 
- Adaptor to fit all electric vehicles

Cleanliness has always been at the forefront of our minds. Our meticulous home, with all new furnishings, will put you right at ease, along with our thorough cleaning of the property between guests.

Guest access
Guests have full access to the entire property.

We do not allow parties at this property. We use a noise alert monitoring system in order to ensure that neighborhood noise levels are respected. There is no electronic video surveillance or audio recording. It simply notifies guests and us when the noise levels has reached a volume that would disturb the neighbors.
